name: Does Homeowners Insurance Cover Hardwood Floor Damage in Everett
title-tag: Does Insurance Cover Hardwood Floor Damage? Everett, WA
meta-description: Sudden water damage: usually covered. Gradual leaks, pets, and wear: no. An Everett flooring contractor on claims, matching rules, and restoration.
post-summary: January 15, 2027 · Insurance pays for sudden, accidental damage — burst pipes, failed appliance lines — and denies everything gradual. Where claims get interesting: whether the whole continuous floor gets refinished to match, and why Everett’s galvanized-pipe mill-era homes see more than their share of the covered kind.
